I am 56 years old and I never went to school. I learned everything from my father and from watching my neighbors. This plot is very small, only 0.05 hectares, with some old trees and other crops growing between them. I own this land, so every year I put manure from my cows and donkeys around the trees. I will not buy chemical fertilizer — one bag costs too much and is too big for this small plot, and I need my cash for the other fields. I use the same trees my father planted; I do not try new seeds. I pull the weeds by hand with my wife and children, and I do not spray chemicals. I do not irrigate; I wait for the rain. We spend about 15 days on this plot over the season, and I do not hire anyone because the children can help.
